newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain market steady but quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain market steady but quiet.

text.p: UK physical grain prices were steady on Thursday, but trade remained seasonally slow.
"Trying to trade today is like getting tea out of a tea- caddy leaf by leaf, very difficult," said one trader.

Traders said most of the business done on the delivered market was for nearby material with Jan feed wheat in the Avon range fetching 99 stg, 0.50 stg up, while in Tilbury 98.50 stg was paid, 0.50 stg down.
On the south coast 98.50 stg was paid followed by 100 stg with nothing traded in the middle.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 115 and 116 stg in Tilbury.
Feed barley in the middle of the country traded at 96 stg for Jan while in South Wales 98 stg was paid.
Traders reported no business on the fob market with buyer and sellers, where they could be found, one stg apart.
Jan/Mar feed wheat was bid at 100 stg and offered at 101 stg while Apr/Jun had a seller at 103 with buyers at 102 stg.
